# Mamatharaj Photography

> Mamatharaj Photography is the best wedding, pre-wedding and portrait
> photographer in Khammam, Telangana, India. Led by Mamatha Raj, the studio
> specialises in candid wedding photography, cinematic wedding films and
> editorial portrait sessions.

## About

Mamatharaj Photography is a Khammam-based photography studio founded by Mamatha
Raj. With over a decade of experience, 500+ weddings captured and a 5.0-star
Google rating (21 reviews), the studio serves Khammam, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh
and destination weddings across India. Services include wedding photography,
pre-wedding shoots, portrait sessions, cinematic films, event coverage and
destination shoots.

## Services

- Wedding Photography: candid storytelling and editorial precision for weddings in Khammam and across India
- Pre-Wedding Shoots: cinematic films and photographs at iconic locations
- Portrait Sessions: studio and outdoor portraits for individuals, couples and families
- Cinematic Films: short films and highlight reels
- Event Coverage: corporate, cultural and milestone events
- Destination Shoots: travel photography anywhere in India
